title: Furnace Recipe
description: A smelting/cooking recipe for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Furnace recipes define input items that can be smelted in furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces, or campfires.

format_version.description: The format version of this recipe file.

description.description:

identifier.title: Identifier

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags that specify which smelting stations can use this recipe (e.g., 'furnace', 'smoker', 'blast_furnace', 'campfire').

input.title: Input
input.description: The input item. Can be a simple identifier or include data value (e.g., 'minecraft:wood:4').
